statement.text:
A draft of the environmental statement prepared in response to Executive Order 11644 has been sent to me for comment. Presumably, I was asked to respond as a member of the State Committee on Federal Land Laws and an alternate on the BLM Multiple Use Advisory Board. But I also would like to react as a fisherman, outdoorsman and frequent ORV user.
I strongly support both the statement and the proposed regulations. However, I do object to the summation statement on page 25--Th short, it represents an attempt to maximize the types of public land uses... --as giving the wrong emphasis and providing an opening to those who oppose even the most modest controls and management practices.
Also, I believe it is absolutely necessary to give BLM enforcement powers. This authority is long overdue.
